liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): Sequence of China Cat, I Know You Rider, and Friend of the Devil was smoking; Jerry repeated Bobby's sun verse before his headlight verse, impressed by the performance [20][23]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Transition from Space to Aiko was shocking, but the first note of Dew was breath-taking [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-09-02.aud.unknown.26094.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 26 songs; 207 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Loud crowd noise distracts during peak musical moments, though music is clear when quiet [1]
- **gd1980-09-02.mtx.sirmick.110785.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 195 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd80-09-02.aud.skankweed.26458.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 183 min; rated 4.84/5 by 32 [3]. Said about its sound: Analog copy was low volume and hissy, yet the performance quality was high [19]
- **gd80-09-02.sbd.miller.28299.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 186 min; rated 4.2/5 by 10 [4]. Said about its sound: Recording exhibits significant hiss, possibly due to FLAC format or multiple source generations [18]
- **gd1980-09-02.sbd.miller.tetzeli.patch-28299.34940.reflac.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 187 min; rated 3.67/5 by 18 [5]

## Around the show

- Venue was hot and crowded, with people pushing from sides and rear [17]
- Crowd included students from nearby colleges like RIT, U of R, and Syracuse [20]
- Travelers arrived in Rochester during bright sunlight, clouds, cold, and rain [25]
- General admission crowd was packed like sardines, with pushing from the back [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-09-02.aud.unknown.26094.sbeok.shnf**: source: Sony PCM-R500 DAT > HHB CDR-850> SoundStream WAV> mkACT SHN [1]
- **gd1980-09-02.mtx.sirmick.110785.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by SIRMick; source: Matrix: 60% sbd/40% aud Recording Info: Discs 1 & 2: SBD -> Cassette Master -> ? -> Cool Edit Pro -> FLAC Disc 3: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> Sonic… [2]. Also: Missing tuning sections patched from SBD; SBD splices patched from audience recording [2]
- **gd80-09-02.aud.skankweed.26458.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [3]. Also: Lineage: Audience FOB to MC to DAT to CDR to EAC to SHN, reseeded by Skankweed [3]
- **gd80-09-02.sbd.miller.28299.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Recording originated from Radio Shack chrome tapes circulating at Oswego State, noted as hissy [22]
- **gd1980-09-02.sbd.miller.tetzeli.patch-28299.34940.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Bill Tetzeli; source: Discs 1 & 2: SBD -> Cassette Master -> ? -> Cool Edit Pro -> FLAC; Disc 3: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD; Encore: (FOB) Nakamichi… [5]. Also: Source possibly from 4th generation cassettes; Bill Tetzeli made the second set seamless [5]
